kjv: in thy book all [my members] were written, [which] in continuance were fashioned
mine: in Your book were written, every one of them, the days that were formed for me
note: kullam "all of them" is explained by the next words yamim yutsaru "days (that) were formed": God's book records the psalmist's days before they began; the KJV supplies "my members", making it a list of body parts.
